chapterInfo.content:
17
Afɔrebɔdeɛ
1 # Lew 22.20 Mfa nantwie anaa odwan a ne ho wɔ dɛm anaa adebɔne biara mmɔ afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ n’akyiwadeɛ.
2 # Deut 13.6-11 Sɛ wɔhunu wo mu, wo nkuro a ɔde rema woɔ no biara mu ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa bi a ɔyɛ deɛ ɛnyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani soɔ bu apam so, 3#Deut 4.19 na ɔkɔ kɔsom anyame foforɔ bi te sɛ owia anaa ɔsrane anaa ɔsoro asafo a mabara no mu biara, 4na wɔka kyerɛ wo na wote a, ɛnneɛ hwehwɛ mu yie; na sɛ wohunu sɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ, na asɛm no wom sɛ wɔayɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi wɔ Israel a, 5ɛnneɛ fa ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa a wadi saa asɛmmɔne yi firi adi wo kuro apono ho, na si no aboɔ ma ɔnwu. 6#Num 35.30; Heb 10.28 Adansefoɔ baanu anaa baasa anomu asɛm so na wɔmfa nkum deɛ ɔsɛ wuo; wɔmmfa ɔdanseni baako anomu asɛm so nnku no. 7Adansefoɔ no nsa na ɛngu ne so kane nku no, na ɛno akyiri no ɔman no nyinaa nsa; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu.
8Sɛ asɛm bi a ɛho atemmuo yɛ wo den te sɛ awudie, manso, ɔpira ne ɔbɔ ne ɔbɔ ntam si, na ɛyɛ wo nkuro mu akasakasa nsɛm bi a, ɛnneɛ sɔre kɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ, 9#2 Be 19.8, 11 na kɔ asɔfoɔ Lewifoɔ ne ɔtemmufoɔ a ɔwɔ so saa berɛ no nkyɛn kɔbisa, na wɔnkyerɛ wo atɛn a buo. 10Na di asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ wo faako a AWURADE bɛkyerɛ no so, na hwɛ na yɛ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ nyinaa. 11#Deut 17.20 Mmara a wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ ne atemmuo a wɔbɛka akyerɛ woɔ no so na die, mmane mfiri asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ no ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum. 12Na onipa a ɔbɛdi ahantansɛm na ɔrentie ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔgyina hɔ som AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anaa ɔtemmufoɔ no, saa onipa no nwu; 13na yi bɔne no firi Israel, na ɔman no nyinaa nte na wɔnsuro, na wɔanni ahantansɛm bio.
Ɔhene yie ne n’asɛdeɛ
14 # 1 Sa 8.5-6 Sɛ woduru asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so na wofa tena so, na woka sɛ: Mɛsi me so hene sɛ amanaman a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no nyinaa a, 15fa deɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi no no si wo so hene; wo nuanom mu bi na fa no si wo so hene; mfa ɔnanani bi a ɔnyɛ wo nua nsi wo so hene. 16#1 Ah 10.25, 28 Nanso ɔhene no mma n’apɔnkɔ nnnɔɔso, na ɔmmma ɔman no nnsane nnkɔ Misraim nkɔpɛ apɔnkɔ dodoɔ; na AWURADE aka akyerɛ mo sɛ monnsane mmfa ɔkwan yi so bio. 17#1 Ah 11.4 Nanso ɔmmma ne yerenom nnnɔɔso, na n’akoma ammane; saa ara na ɔmmma ne dwetɛ ne sika nnnɔɔso pii.
18Na sɛ ɔte n’ahennie adwa so a, ɔnhwɛ mmara yi nwoma a ɛda asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ anim no so ntwerɛ bi mfa; 19na ɛntena ne nkyɛn, na ɔnkenkan mu, ne nkwa nna nyinaa, na wasua AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn suro, ne mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa ne ahyɛdeɛ yi so hwɛ ne ɛsodie, 20#Deut 5.32 na n’akoma amma ne ho so ansene ne nuanom, na wammane amfiri mmara nsɛm no ho ankɔ nifa anaa benkum, na ama ne nna aware n’ahennie mu, ɔno ne ne mma, Israel mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Mfa nantwie anaa odwan a ne ho wɔ dɛm anaa adebɔne biara mmɔ afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ n’akyiwadeɛ.
Sɛ wɔhunu wo mu, wo nkuro a ɔde rema woɔ no biara mu ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa bi a ɔyɛ deɛ ɛnyɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ani soɔ bu apam so, na ɔkɔ kɔsom anyame foforɔ bi te sɛ owia anaa ɔsrane anaa ɔsoro asafo a mabara no mu biara, na wɔka kyerɛ wo na wote a, ɛnneɛ hwehwɛ mu yie; na sɛ wohunu sɛ ɛyɛ nokorɛ, na asɛm no wom sɛ wɔayɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi wɔ Israel a, ɛnneɛ fa ɔbarima anaa ɔbaa a wadi saa asɛmmɔne yi firi adi wo kuro apono ho, na si no aboɔ ma ɔnwu. Adansefoɔ baanu anaa baasa anomu asɛm so na wɔmfa nkum deɛ ɔsɛ wuo; wɔmmfa ɔdanseni baako anomu asɛm so nnku no. Adansefoɔ no nsa na ɛngu ne so kane nku no, na ɛno akyiri no ɔman no nyinaa nsa; na yi bɔne no firi wo mu.
Sɛ asɛm bi a ɛho atemmuo yɛ wo den te sɛ awudie, manso, ɔpira ne ɔbɔ ne ɔbɔ ntam si, na ɛyɛ wo nkuro mu akasakasa nsɛm bi a, ɛnneɛ sɔre kɔ faako a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ, na kɔ asɔfoɔ Lewifoɔ ne ɔtemmufoɔ a ɔwɔ so saa berɛ no nkyɛn kɔbisa, na wɔnkyerɛ wo atɛn a buo. Na di asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ wo faako a AWURADE bɛkyerɛ no so, na hwɛ na yɛ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ nyinaa. Mmara a wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ ne atemmuo a wɔbɛka akyerɛ woɔ no so na die, mmane mfiri asɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ woɔ no ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum. Na onipa a ɔbɛdi ahantansɛm na ɔrentie ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔgyina hɔ som AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anaa ɔtemmufoɔ no, saa onipa no nwu; na yi bɔne no firi Israel, na ɔman no nyinaa nte na wɔnsuro, na wɔanni ahantansɛm bio.

Sɛ woduru asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no so na wofa tena so, na woka sɛ: Mɛsi me so hene sɛ amanaman a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no nyinaa a, fa deɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn bɛyi no no si wo so hene; wo nuanom mu bi na fa no si wo so hene; mfa ɔnanani bi a ɔnyɛ wo nua nsi wo so hene. Nanso ɔhene no mma n’apɔnkɔ nnnɔɔso, na ɔmmma ɔman no nnsane nnkɔ Misraim nkɔpɛ apɔnkɔ dodoɔ; na AWURADE aka akyerɛ mo sɛ monnsane mmfa ɔkwan yi so bio. Nanso ɔmmma ne yerenom nnnɔɔso, na n’akoma ammane; saa ara na ɔmmma ne dwetɛ ne sika nnnɔɔso pii.
Na sɛ ɔte n’ahennie adwa so a, ɔnhwɛ mmara yi nwoma a ɛda asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ anim no so ntwerɛ bi mfa; na ɛntena ne nkyɛn, na ɔnkenkan mu, ne nkwa nna nyinaa, na wasua AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn suro, ne mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa ne ahyɛdeɛ yi so hwɛ ne ɛsodie, na n’akoma amma ne ho so ansene ne nuanom, na wammane amfiri mmara nsɛm no ho ankɔ nifa anaa benkum, na ama ne nna aware n’ahennie mu, ɔno ne ne mma, Israel mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
